context.transcript:
This is the Centerville Department of Transportation.
How can I help you?
Hello.
I'm calling about the survey the City is conducting about extending the bus routes.
I'd love to have a bus stop near my apartment, so I've been trying to respond to the survey online.
It doesn't seem to be working for me, though.
Oh, yes.
I'm sorry.
Our survey webpage has been down for several hours.
I've been getting a lot of calls about it.
We expect it to be back up and running by 8 o'clock this evening.
Thanks.
I'll try it again later tonight.
context.transcript_translation:
这里是森特维尔交通部。
请问有什么可以帮您的？
您好。
我打电话来是关于城市正在进行的延长公交路线的调查。
我很希望在我公寓附近有一个公交站，所以我一直在尝试在线回复这份调查。
不过，它似乎对我来说无法使用。
哦，是的。
对不起。
我们的调查网页已经停用了好几个小时了。
我接到了很多关于这个的电话。
我们预计到今晚八点之前会恢复运行。
谢谢。
我稍晚些时候再试一次。
